text: The Vantawng Khawhthla  is located 5 kilometres (3.1 mi) south of Thenzawl in Serchhip district in the Indian state of Mizoram. It is the highest uninterrupted waterfall in Mizoram.  It is about 92 kilometres (57 miles) away from Aizawl.
best_time: October to April (dry season with vibrant festivals like Hornbill, Bihu, and Wangala)
